detailed_descriptions.en: The nightshift is yours! CURE is a co-op simulator that allows you and your friends to manage an overnight Emergency Room during the beginning stages of the apocalypse. Order supplies and manage your hospital’s budget - once patients (and other things) start arriving, things get hectic! Diagnose your patients with a variety of interactive tools. Symptoms will get weirder as the apocalypse unfolds, keep an eye on what comes through your doors. As you earn more, expand and upgrade your hospital. Growing your hospital unlocks new diagnostic tools to help your patients feel better, faster. Customize and decorate your hospital to create the hospital of your dreams! Sometimes patients will need … unconventional treatments. Even though you swore to do no harm as a doctor, sometimes you will need to do the right amount of harm. CURE stands out by putting creators and communities first, allowing your stream audience to participate in and influence the game. This unique hybrid of simulation and action gameplay, combined with deep Twitch and Discord integration, offers a truly one-of-a-kind experience. Fast-Paced Patient Care: Diagnose and treat patients with weird symptoms in a chaotic, first-person environment. Will you put them in normal care or quarantine? The choice is yours, and the clock is ticking. Strategic Management: Amidst the chaos, you'll need to manage your hospital effectively. Set up new equipment, manage critical inventory, and build up your hospital. Organize and design your hospital to meet your needs. Co-Op Fun: Play with up to six friends in a fight for survival, where teamwork is essential to keeping your patients - and yourselves - alive. Twitch Integration: Our Shoutout Engine connects your live stream to the game. Your audience can participate as patient NPCs during live sessions. Hybrid Gameplay: Experience a unique blend of first-person action and simulation management. Fend off attacks, while treating unique illnesses and managing the administrative side of things. Progression & Unlocks: Unlock new medicine, diagnostic tools, weapons, and story insights as you survive more nights and save more lives.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The nightshift is yours! CURE is a co-op simulator that allows you and your friends to manage an overnight Emergency Room during the beginning stages of the apocalypse.

Order supplies and manage your hospital’s budget - once patients (and other things) start arriving, things get hectic!

Diagnose your patients with a variety of interactive tools. Symptoms will get weirder as the apocalypse unfolds, keep an eye on what comes through your doors.

As you earn more, expand and upgrade your hospital. Growing your hospital unlocks new diagnostic tools to help your patients feel better, faster. Customize and decorate your hospital to create the hospital of your dreams!

Sometimes patients will need … unconventional treatments. Even though you swore to do no harm as a doctor, sometimes you will need to do the right amount of harm.

CURE stands out by putting creators and communities first, allowing your stream audience to participate in and influence the game.

This unique hybrid of simulation and action gameplay, combined with deep Twitch and Discord integration, offers a truly one-of-a-kind experience.

  • Fast-Paced Patient Care: Diagnose and treat patients with weird symptoms in a chaotic, first-person environment. Will you put them in normal care or quarantine? The choice is yours, and the clock is ticking.

  • Strategic Management: Amidst the chaos, you'll need to manage your hospital effectively. Set up new equipment, manage critical inventory, and build up your hospital. Organize and design your hospital to meet your needs.

  • Co-Op Fun: Play with up to six friends in a fight for survival, where teamwork is essential to keeping your patients - and yourselves - alive.

  • Twitch Integration: Our Shoutout Engine connects your live stream to the game. Your audience can participate as patient NPCs during live sessions.

  • Hybrid Gameplay: Experience a unique blend of first-person action and simulation management. Fend off attacks, while treating unique illnesses and managing the administrative side of things.

  • Progression & Unlocks: Unlock new medicine, diagnostic tools, weapons, and story insights as you survive more nights and save more lives.
